full_reference: Project-author selection of the published pooled D. fuscus assembly span as the conditional Feulgen calibration anchor
notes: Author confirmed that Process_413/specimen 32469 and Process_414/specimen 32470 were the intended D. fuscus standards and were stained in the same runs as the unknowns. The selected source value is the rounded 16.1-Gbp pooled assembly reported by Myers et al. 2025; using 1 pg = 0.978 Gbp gives 16.462167689 pg/1C. This is an assembly-derived conditional reference value, not a direct cytometric C-value. Absolute calibration remains unresolved until the exact target-to-run-to-standard map is recorded and the standard slides are reviewed under the same QC rules as the targets.
